obsiss.collective_method: context-conditioned full-16D individual Obsiss votes fused with same-row candidate-specific P/R coherence; candidate-wise median and IQR; leave-one-out or partition stability; geometric population growth only when needed

population_profile.individual_perspective: L1-normalized signed 16D profile from its own wh/wp checkpoint row plus its own prompt activation and fixed cross-observation permutation
population_profile.collective_rule: candidate-wise median of individual Obsiss votes; interquartile disagreement; P/R same-row candidate coherence rank-fused with 16-channel evidence; leave-one-out or disjoint-partition stability
population_profile.interpretation: Obsiss are distinct observation perspectives, not model weight-sharing units. Stability is not factual correctness or general-intelligence certification.
population_profile.fusion: candidate-level scalar rank fusion after each space is independently evaluated

interpretation.provenance: TRAIN-only language statistics and the supplied current dialogue; one-hop context associations only; generated tokens are not promoted to semantic anchors; no prompt/answer lookup table or target-answer templates.
interpretation.known_semantic_scope: The named channels are measurable lexical, sequential, morphological, recurrence, discourse and marker observations. Negation/temporal channels detect explicit cues but do not implement a complete semantic parser.
interpretation.convergence_scope: Two distinct tests are reported: V6 dynamics reach NO_ACTIVE_NEIGHBORS or a SHA-256 period-one state fingerprint repeats, and candidate rankings remain stable under leave-one-Obsiss-out or disjoint observer partitions. A hash repeat is cryptographic evidence, not a collision-free mathematical identity proof; VECTOR_LENGTH_REACHED is not convergence. Neither test certifies factual correctness or general intelligence.
